content.text: Your project folder is organized in a simple, intuitive structure. Here's what each file and folder does.
The root of your template contains the main HTML files and folders for assets:

sections.code:
your-site/
├── index.html          # Home page
├── css/                # Stylesheets
│   ├── global.css      # Global styles
│   └── home.css        # Home page styles
├── js/                 # JavaScript
│   ├── global.js       # Global scripts
│   └── home.js         # Home page scripts
└── data.json           # Your editable content

content.text: This is the most important file for you. It contains all the text content for your website in a simple JSON format. Open it in any text editor and replace the values with your own information.
For multi-page templates, each page has its own HTML file (e.g., `initiative.html`, `gallery.html`). You can customize each page individually.
